title: MCP get_neighbors
summary: MCP tool: the call-graph neighbourhood of a symbol within 1..3 hops
intro: Ask an MCP client for get_neighbors to see everything one to three resolved call edges away from a symbol, callers and callees alike, each with its fewest hops. The answer is capped at 200 rows and always states how many were omitted.

questions.ask: What is around this routine in the call graph?
